What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking hasn’t updated yet, it’s usually because the carrier hasn’t scanned the package after the label was created. This can take a little time.
Try these steps:
Check your email (including spam) for the tracking number.
Log into your account and review the order details.
Use the carrier’s tracking page (like UPS) to see the latest status.
For most parcel shipments, tracking can take 7–10 business days after the order is placed to appear or start updating.
If it still hasn’t updated after that timeframe, further assistance may be needed to review the shipment details.
Please note that for nationwide orders, we offer indoor drop-off only. Guests can enter their zip code on this page to view the delivery options available in their area: https://www.livingspaces.com/delivery
